title: Weather observer injured in an encounter and given a medical discharge

tellings.quote: One observer was even injured in an encounter with something and given a medical discharge.

plain: In the 1960s, one Air Force weather observer working on the Indian Springs ranges in Nevada was injured in an encounter "with something" and given a medical discharge, Michels says. He tells it himself, without naming a source, while introducing a former weather observer named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years there around tall, white beings. Michels does not say what the something was.
